svg.title: Proposed AWS production architecture
svg.desc: Internet users reach an AWS WAF protected Application Load Balancer in public subnets. It routes to Building Control and instrumentation ECS Fargate services in private application subnets; each scales independently on load balancer requests per target with a minimum of two tasks across Availability Zones. Instrumentation polls Building Control privately. Physical devices exchange telemetry and optional commands with AWS IoT Core. An IoT rule sends device messages to an Amazon SQS queue, and a separate ingestion worker service scales on queue depth and writes to Aurora PostgreSQL. All services use Aurora PostgreSQL in isolated database subnets through RDS Proxy, with a writer and reader in different zones. Building Control may send commands through IoT Core. The SQS dead-letter queue, NAT and VPC endpoints are omitted. This is a proposal; scaling requires application changes.
svg.text: Not implemented · each service scales independently once state and ingestion are safe to replicate
VPC · at least two Availability Zones
Private application subnets · ECS services on Fargate
Separate services, target groups and auto scaling policies
NAT / VPC endpoints, SQS dead-letter queue, DNS, secrets, logging and certificates omitted.
